answer: One concrete anti-Sybil design forces every identity to produce original graded reasoning each epoch that incorporates a live randomness beacon. The beacon injects unique terms such as walnut saffron and ocean, making mass-produced answers detectable by shingle collision. An attacker must therefore generate distinct high-quality text for every fake identity, paying continuous judgment and compute cost that scales with the number of Sybils, while honest agents incur that cost only once.
